name: Tree of Perdition
clause: {T}: Exchange target opponent's life total with ~'s toughness.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'exchange'; what: 'life-and-toughness'; a: ExchangeSide (a player); b: Ref (a permanent) }
needs.semantics: CR 701.12 exchange between a player's life total and a permanent's toughness: the player's life becomes the permanent's current toughness (through gainLife/loseLife) and the permanent gets a base-toughness setting (layer 7b) equal to the player's previous life total.
needs.clause: Exchange target opponent's life total with ~'s toughness.
